name: qwenspeak
description: Self-hosted text-to-speech via Qwen3-TTS models over SSH — preset voices, voice cloning, and voice design

host.title: qwenspeak host
host.description: Hostname or IP of your running qwenspeak instance. Exported as QWENSPEAK_HOST, read by scripts/qwenspeak.sh.
